attributes.provenance: src/game/world/newcam.c::DebugCamControlInputs, worktree GDL-Claude-ExactCamera, work_claim.exact-camera-family.20260831.v1, commit 9f35cf2b7. Closed a residual parked since 2026-08-23 as the 'P6 goto-pair min-clamp head' after ternary/goto/label forms had all been tried in the original comparison polarity. Three measured steps: negated guard (baseline, real 6, cror+bne) -> if/else arm swap (multiset 4t->1t, cror gone, one b short, 272/273) -> ternary (multiset 1t->0t IDENTICAL, 273/273) -> frame pad -8 (real 0, EXACT).
attributes.scope: MWCC GC 1.2.5 family; applies to any single-sided clamp of a FLOAT against a constant (`if (x <= K) x = K;` / `if (x >= K) x = K;`) whose target disassembly shows an ordered conditional branch plus an unconditional `b` where the reconstruction emits `cror`+`bne`. Companion, opposite-direction case to claim.law.load-then-conditional-overwrite-vs-ternary (which prefers the SHORTER load-then-overwrite form); the two together mean the guard-vs-ternary choice must be read off the target, never assumed.

subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: A `cror`/`bne` pair in YOUR build where target has an ordered float branch plus an unconditional `b` is NOT a scheduling or register residual -- it is the tell that your source states the clamp as a NEGATED guard while the original stated it as a TERNARY, and it is closed by flipping the comparison operator and rewriting the statement as a ternary. Mechanism: to invert `x <= K` IEEE-correctly MWCC must build the unordered-safe complement, costing `cror eq,lt,eq` + `bne` (2 instructions, no `b`). When the source instead reads `x = x > K ? x : K;`, MWCC emits the full ternary diamond -- branch-if-NOT-cond (`ble`, a single ordered branch, no cror) to the false arm, then the true arm's own unconditional `b` to the merge -- even when the true arm is EMPTY because its value is already in the destination register. The empty-arm `b` is exactly the target-only `b` such residuals show, and it is why an if/else with an elided then-arm gets you to one-instruction-short but not to exact: MWCC collapses an empty statement block but never collapses a ternary's arm block. TWO PRECONDITIONS, both load-bearing: (1) the comparison operator must be flipped, not just the arms reordered -- keeping `<=` and swapping arms reintroduces the cror, because the cost is in negating `<=`, not in the layout; (2) the ternary's arm order must place the MEMORY/pass-through value first and the constant second (`x > K ? x : K`), so the branch MWCC needs is the direct complement of the written condition. VERIFY WITH NaN, which also settles which form is semantically right: PPC `ble` is branch-if-not-greater and IS taken for an unordered compare, so a target using `ble` to reach the constant arm clamps NaN to the constant -- the ternary's semantics -- whereas the `<= K` guard propagates the NaN. When the target's bytes and your guard disagree on NaN, the target is the authority and the rewrite is a semantic CORRECTION, not a respelling. FOLLOW-THROUGH: converting a guard to a ternary commonly changes the frame size by 8 bytes (a temporary that no longer needs a slot, or one that now does). Do not judge the probe on `real`, which regresses hard from the uniform displacement shift -- arbitrate on the `--ops` multiset, and once it reads IDENTICAL apply claim.law.uniform-stack-displacement-delta-is-a-pad-applied-last to the declared pad. In this instance the sequence read real 6 -> 83 -> 10 -> 0 while the multiset read 4t -> 1t -> 0t -> 0t; reverting on `real` at any intermediate step would have discarded the match. SCREEN FOR IT CHEAPLY: `fndiff --ops` reporting `target-only: +1 b +1 ble/blt` against `ours-only: -1 cror -1 bne` (or `-1 bge`) is the whole signature, and it recurs -- in this project's camera/missile TUs alone, combat.c::StandardCamera_8002B828 and combat.c::PlayerStartMissile both carry it, though for INTEGER guards (where the complement is a single free `bge`) the same rewrite does NOT reach the target: the integer instance survived both an else-if chain and a goto/label form unchanged, so this law is specific to compares whose negation costs an extra instruction.
